You can now start working on these tasks, beginning with Task 1 (Set up monorepo structure and core dependencies). The recommended workflow is to:

1. Use `task-master set-status --id=1.1 --status=in-progress` to mark the first subtask as in progress
2. Complete the implementation for that subtask
3. Mark it as done with `task-master set-status --id=1.1 --status=done`
4. Move to the next task using `task-master next`

The tasks-summary.md file provides a quick reference to all the tasks and their dependencies.
